code_scope: robot benchmark; frozen simulator core unchanged
controller_state_source: 2 kHz causal spatial learned event-state model
event_estimator_boundary: spatial learned model consumes causal five-bin event tensors only; GT is used for supervised training and offline evaluator metrics, not inference
shared_lift_gate_boundary: both GT and event paths use the same ProprioceptiveGripGate and ProprioceptiveLiftStabilityMonitor; the grip gate reads finger joint positions/velocities and close-command time, while the commanded lift probe and full lift are monitored using finger-joint drift/velocity and probe-command time. No target state/contact/segmentation/depth enters either control gate.

provenance.r0_7_gripper_evidence: successful episodes settle near 19 mm/finger; missed low-speed rollout reached about 11 mm aperture and did not hold bilateral contact
provenance.research_approval: same GT-free proprioceptive completion gate may be shared by GT and event paths; strict scorer unchanged
provenance.probe_monitor_evidence: development traces at code f20315e: centered strict hold max finger-q drift 0.2 um; front-edge stable seed 20.9 um; front-edge unstable seed crossed 30 um at 343.5 ms after lift and strict slip exceeded 10 mm at 529 ms; candidate thresholds require new-seed validation

close_time_estimator.velocity_source: causal rolling least-squares slope of decoded target-plane XY over recent valid observations
close_time_estimator.status: candidate; evaluate at matched 1 kHz/2 kHz five-bin decision windows

proprioceptive_grip_gate.status: candidate; negative and real-hold contact regressions required before strict oracle rollout

closure_lead_speed_schedule.status: candidate restored to R0.5 strict-oracle-validated speed rule; R0.8 new-seed shared-gate confirmation required

proprioceptive_lift_confirmation.status: candidate causal finger-joint stability monitor during 40 mm probe and full lift; no target GT/contact/seg/depth input; validate false reject/false accept on fresh episodes

cost_boundary: episode_loop_artifact_wall_s includes complete rollouts and per-episode trace/video/event/CSV/JSON artifact generation, but excludes environment initialization and final run_manifest/SHA256SUMS finalization. The launch wrapper must record the full Python process wall time as the end-to-end cost.
pixel_response_model_boundary: Direct linear-HDR input and DvsEmulator are shared with the plugin; Ours temporal reconstruction and V2E frame interpolation are bypassed. This ideal synthetic threshold model is uncalibrated to EVK4.
visibility_evaluation_boundary: uses evaluator-only segmentation and matched-pose target-only render; those data do not enter the event state source or controller
